_comment: Sample configuration for parallel report execution by datasource

_notes.mode: Choose 'sequential' for traditional one-at-a-time execution, or 'parallel_by_datasource' to run reports from different databases concurrently
_notes.max_concurrent: Maximum reports running at once. Recommended: 2 for 8GB RAM, 3 for 16GB RAM
_notes.query_timeout_seconds: Per-report query timeout in seconds. Each retry attempt adds 60s on top of this baseline (e.g. attempt 2 = query_timeout_seconds + 60). 60s is sufficient for almost all PostGIS/Arango queries in this project.
_notes.deprioritized_reports: List of report names to push to the back of their datasource queue. Useful for known slow reports (e.g. ['Report0171']) so they don't block faster reports. These reports are still executed, just after all others.
_notes.max_concurrent_per_datasource: Optional. Override the per-datasource worker cap so a hung PostGIS query cannot block the Arango pipeline. Must be a dict like {"PostGIS": 1, "ArangoDB": 2}. A bare integer or string here is ignored (a warning is logged) and the global max_concurrent is used instead. Capped at 3 in total.
